purpose: Official Groww documentation for explaining brokerage, transaction charges, deductions, and other fees. Verified customer review confusion is provided only as context.
review_confusion_context: Customer reviews mention being charged more than the advertised Rs 20 brokerage.
Customer reviews describe fees as hidden, unclear, or unexpectedly deducted.
Customer reviews mention confusion around brokerage, charges, deductions, and wallet balances.

relevant_facts: Equity brokerage is shown as Rs 20 or 0.1% per executed order, whichever is lower, with a minimum of Rs 5.
DP charges are shown for sell transactions, including depository and Groww components, with a Rs 0 Groww component for sale value below Rs 100 debit value.
Regulatory and statutory charges include STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charge, SEBI turnover charge, DP charges, IPFT charge, and related charges.

GST of 18% applies on brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges, IPFT, SEBI turnover charges, delayed payment charges, DDPI charges, KYC modification request charges, API charges, and auto square-off charges.
Auto square-off charges are listed at Rs 50 per position for open intraday positions squared off by the system.
Other charges listed include delayed payment charges of 0.05% per day, Pledge/Unpledge charges of Rs 20 per ISIN, and UPI mandate balance equity brokerage of 1% of order value with no maximum cap.
verified_excerpts: Equity Brokerage: Rs 20 / 0.1% per executed order, whichever is lower, minimum Rs 5
DP charges (per sell transaction): Depository: Rs 3.5 (male) and Rs 3.25 (female), Groww: Rs 16.5, Rs 0 for less than 100 debit value

18% GST on Brokerage, DP charges, Exchange Transaction charges, IPFT, SEBI Turnover charges, Delayed payment charges, DDPI charges, KYC modification request charges, API charges and Auto Square-Off charges
Auto Square-off charges: Rs 50 per position for open intraday positions by system
official_sources.limitations: Pricing may change; this records the page as accessed on 2026-10-14 and should be rechecked before making fee claims to customers.

relevant_facts: Intraday brokerage is Rs 20 or 0.1% of trade value per order, whichever is lower.
If brokerage per trade is less than Rs 5, the minimum charge is the lower of Rs 5 or 2.5% of trade value.

Intraday charges listed on the page include STT of 0.025% only on sell orders, stamp duty of 0.003% only on buy orders, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover charges, IPFT charge, and GST of 18%.
A charge of Rs 50 plus GST per position is deducted if open positions are not squared off before 3:20 PM.
verified_excerpts: Brokerage: Rs 20 or 0.1% of trade value per order, whichever is lower. However, if the brokerage per trade is less than Rs 5, then the minimum charge will be the lower of Rs 5 or 2.5% of your trade value
Investor Protection Fund Trust Charge (buy & sell): 0.0001% (NSE)
If you don't square off your open positions before 3:20 PM, a charge of Rs 50 + GST per position will be deducted from your Groww Balance.
official_sources.limitations: The page is specific to intraday charges and should not be treated as a complete description of all Groww charges.

relevant_facts: Equity trading fee is either Rs 20 or 0.1% of trade value, whichever is lower, with a minimum charge of Rs 5.
SEBI guidelines state that brokerage charges for equity delivery trades cannot exceed 2.5% of trade value.
F&O trading has a flat fee of Rs 20 per order.
Additional charges such as regulatory fees, statutory charges, and penalties are not from Groww and are imposed by the exchange.
verified_excerpts: Equity Trading: The fee is either Rs 20 or 0.1% of your trade value, whichever is lower. The minimum charge is Rs 5.
Regulatory Cap: According to SEBI guidelines, brokerage charges for equity delivery trades cannot exceed 2.5% of the trade value.
F&O Trading: A flat fee of Rs 20 per order.
Additional Charges: Other fees, like regulatory fees, statutory charges, and penalties, are not from Groww. These are imposed by the exchange.
official_sources.limitations: The page gives a summary and directs users to the pricing section for a detailed breakdown.
